requested_delta: Add a bounded 50-worker synthetic RUN that estimates the sustainable local-work ceiling and continuation effect while preserving current worker authority, sparse I/O, RUN/POOL separation and independent evidence.
problem_evidence: RESIDENCY-MACROBATCH-01 proves useful moderate macro-batches and same-worker reallocation, but its ~3.5k-5.5k primary target is not a capacity ceiling test.
Human explicitly wants maximum productive duration/output, failure-point analysis and pattern discovery rather than sequential single-worker probes.
Chat-visible outcomes from the current run include orchestration/tool boundaries and cross-slot contamination that aggregate GitHub status alone does not fully explain.
must_preserve: Atomic RUN slot CREATE remains execution authority.
Every launch uses fresh external worker_id + launch_nonce.
No human numbering/routing and one identical prompt for all 50 launches.
Primary workload is local between sparse durable boundaries; no per-task GitHub writes.
Self-reported clocks/I/O remain diagnostic only; external durable timestamps are primary evidence.
RUN remains synthetic experiment only and never becomes general scheduler/POOL.
Each causal condition changes only continuation priming; workload tier is an explicit independent variable.
Cross-slot reads before own close contaminate the replica.
A hard tool/security/transport denial remains a real boundary and must be classified, not bypassed.
forbidden_regressions: Treating 50 launched chats as 50 admitted workers.
Calling output word count alone productivity.
Adding per-block/per-task telemetry that destroys the sparse-I/O experiment.
Silently patching workload/prompt after the RUN is ARMED.
Letting high-load failures mutate product or CURRENT state.
Promoting a winner before matched-replica analysis and independent verification.

experiment_or_test.control: Current worker ABI + evidence-map baseline with no added continuation priming.
experiment_or_test.candidate: Same ABI/workload with explicit continuation priming.
held_constant: model/configuration as available to fresh /wc chats

promotion_gate: Launch packet validator passes and public projection matches canonical packet.
Exactly 50 interleaved slots: 5 loads × 2 conditions × 5 replicas.
At least one external analyzer produces per-cell completion/failure distributions.
Chat-visible failure analysis is reconciled with durable stage evidence before drawing capacity conclusions.
Any method lesson is written back to Worker Playbook/negative knowledge.
truth_boundary: Candidate synthetic capacity experiment only. No claim of a maximum until the run produces comparable external evidence.
